Chapter 193: Chapter 2 Rule Crystal (Subscribe Request)_2

Chapter 193: Chapter 2 Rule Crystal (Subscribe Request)_2

The problem with this ‘post’ was.

Is it better to understand one rule or multiple rules?

At the time, Lin Yuan gave an answer based on himself, never expecting a reply from the owner of the post.

After all, the ‘post’ had been published 23,000 years ago.

The owner of the ‘post’ might have long since died.

“How can one rule govern ten thousand? Is it the Time Great Dao or the Space Great Dao?”

...

Lin Yuan looked at the reply from the owner of the ‘post’ and fell into deep thought.

He used his own Taiji Dao to govern the myriad daos, but as for the Time Great Dao and the Space Great Dao, they were too remote for Lin Yuan.

Whether it was the Rule of Time or Space Rules, both were among the supreme rules, only accessible to existences beyond the Sixth Rank.

Lin Yuan was merely at the Fifth Rank; even with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he could hardly perceive time and space.

“With the rules mastered as the framework and many other rules as the flesh, naturally, one can govern ten thousand daos…”

Lin Yuan thought for a while before voicing his viewpoint.

…

In the distant reaches, a massive research planet.

Great Scholar Tai’e was just yawning, his research work was now at a halt, and he was free for the next few decades.

“Hmm?”

“A reply?”

Great Scholar Tai’e immediately perked up.

To be informed the moment his question was answered, Great Scholar Tai’e had marked the Founders’ World as ‘special concern.’

He would receive notifications the moment there was any news.

“Framework? Flesh? Too vague…”

Great Scholar Tai’e frowned slightly and continued, “How exactly do you build your own framework of rules?”

…

Central Continent Manor on Canglan Star.

Lin Yuan had just replied when he received a new question.

“This person… is just squatting there, huh?”

Lin Yuan scrutinized the inquiry before carefully responding, “Combining the Power of Taiyin with the Power of Taiyang to form a stable micro-domain, accommodating myriad daos…”

…

“This… is he planning to ‘open a realm’?”

Great Scholar Tai’e marveled, following his brief exchange with Lin Yuan.

Great Scholar Tai’e determined that Lin Yuan was not another scholar.

To become an Evolver Scholar, one must at least create and cultivate a new, stable Eighth Rank Evolutionary Path.

This meant that an Evolver Scholar was at least a Eighth Rank Evolver.

The answers Lin Yuan gave him, while not wrong, didn’t seem to come from an Eighth Rank Evolver.

At least, the formation of a stable domain combining the Power of Taiyin and the Power of Taiyang was akin to a nascent form of ‘opening a realm.’

“Impressive, preparing for ‘opening a realm’ before reaching the Eighth Rank, and without any teacher’s guidance, such limitless potential…”

Great Scholar Tai’e murmured to himself.

“No wonder the Goddess of Wisdom guards him so closely…” Great Scholar Tai’e glanced around.

He was well aware that, as a scholar like him, he was constantly under the surveillance of the Goddess of Wisdom, as much for protection as to prevent him from acting out.

An Evolver Scholar going mad could have unpredictable consequences.

“Let’s ask a few more questions…”

Interest piqued, it had been a long time since Great Scholar Tai’e had encountered such an engaging junior.

…

Following that.

Great Scholar Tai’e and Lin Yuan talked for over half an hour.

“This…”

Great Scholar Tai’e watched in astonishment as, through his subtle guidance, even discussed other methods of ‘opening a realm.’

Great Scholar Tai’e clearly felt that the so-called methods of ‘opening a realm’ were completely unknown to Lin Yuan, who didn’t even know what the methods of ‘opening a realm’ were.

But as the conversation with Great Scholar Tai’e deepened, Lin Yuan quickly grasped the understanding of several other ‘opening a realm’ methods, terrifyingly improving.

So much so that even he, an Evolver Scholar, was shocked.

“Is he pretending or does he genuinely not know?”

Great Scholar Tai’e was somewhat baffled.

From Lin Yuan’s tone while answering, Great Scholar Tai’e was sure he was genuinely unaware and had never encountered the methods of ‘opening a realm.’

Yet if he truly didn’t know, how could his grasp of the principles of ‘opening a realm’ advance so rapidly? He understood them after just a few hints?

“A genius, a peerless genius.”

Great Scholar Tai’e immediately rose and paced back and forth.

“Eh?”

“Has he logged off?”

Great Scholar Tai’e discovered that Lin Yuan had suddenly disconnected from the Virtual World.

…

Canglan Star, Central Continent Manor.

His chat with Great Scholar Tai’e had deeply impacted Lin Yuan, forcing him to disconnect and return to the real World to focus on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“With Taiji governing ten thousand daos.”

“But what if it isn’t Taiji?”

“Can it still govern ten thousand daos?”

Lin Yuan’s mind burst with countless spiritual lights.

“You have Against-Heaven’s Understanding, you analyze one Dao that controls all other Daos, and continue to refine the Martial Path Evolutionary Path…]

…

“You have Against-Heaven’s Understanding, you analyze one Dao that controls all other Daos, and continue to refine the Martial Path Evolutionary Path…]

…

“You have Against-Heaven’s Understanding, you analyze one Dao that controls all other Daos, and continue to refine the Martial Path Evolutionary Path…]

…

Lin Yuan fell into deep cultivation.

He even blocked most of the external perceptions.

Fortunately, Lin Yuan often did this, and his parents had basically gotten used to it — as long as Lin Yuan didn’t come out, they wouldn’t actively disturb him.

Several days later.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

This period of seclusion had a significant impact on him, even causing him to start rethinking the foundations of Martial Tao.

“That person, at least a High-Rank Evolver, is no weaker than my teacher…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Through just a few conversations, Lin Yuan had learned a great deal.

While Lin Yuan continued to ponder.

The alert from the smart assistant rang out.

“Master, you have a delivery.”

“It’s sent by Shuntong Group, it’s S-level encrypted.”

“A delivery?” Lin Yuan was slightly stunned.

But upon hearing ‘Shuntong Group’ and S-level encryption,

He was immediately shocked.

Shuntong Group, the largest transportation group in the cosmic human civilization, its business scope is not limited to the Human Alliance.

In the cosmic starry skies, human civilization dominates far and wide, encountering numerous enemies, but also many allies and affiliated races.

Anywhere the human civilization can reach is within the transport range of Shuntong Group.

As for reliability and secrecy… Shuntong Group is an officially endorsed group by human civilization, absolutely confidential and reliable.

It is of the same echelon as the Central Galaxy Bank.

Of course.

Shuntong Group’s fees are very high, starting from billions at the very least.

The price for S-level encrypted delivery begins at a hundred billion.

As for how much exactly, it depends on the size of the item and whether it has other functions that affect the use.

For instance, transporting a stone versus transporting a planet, the prices naturally differ.

And S-level encrypted transport is among the high-level services of Shuntong Group, accompanied by eight Sixth Rank Evolvers and one Seventh Rank Evolver as escorts.

Their movements are kept completely confidential, apart from Lin Yuan, the recipient, outsiders could not possibly know.

“When did I…”

Lin Yuan was somewhat hesitant.

At that moment,

Chikun Star Lord suddenly sent a message.

“Hahaha, my dear disciple, the thing should have arrived, right?”

“Is it from the teacher?” Lin Yuan felt slightly reassured.

If he had not figured out who it was from, Lin Yuan would most likely not accept it.

But now…

“Teacher, what is it that needs S-level encryption by Shuntong Group?” Lin Yuan was a bit heartbroken, that’s a hundred billion civilization currency.

“You will know once you have it.”

Chikun Star Lord said mysteriously.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He immediately left the main building.

He went outside to the manor.

A man dressed in a black uniform was already waiting there.

This man appeared very ordinary, no different from other delivery personnel.

But Lin Yuan knew, to ensure that the item was delivered into the hands of the recipient, the last person to handle it was often the strongest in the transport team.

Shuntong Group’s S-level encryption required a Seventh Rank Evolver to accompany.

That is to say, this man in a black uniform was a Seventh Rank Evolver.

“Sir.”

The man in the black uniform was slightly respectful.

Being able to afford Shuntong Group’s S-level encryption, his status even when surpassing Sixth Rank, was extremely high.

“Hello.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

He then went through fingerprint, pupil, and soul wave authentication.

After confirming that Lin Yuan was the recipient himself,

The man in the black uniform handed over a regular black briefcase to Lin Yuan.

“Huh?”

The moment Lin Yuan received the briefcase, his expression subtly changed.
